# Textbench

> Case conversion, cleanup, encoding, hashing, generators, JSON/YAML/CSV conversion, regex testing and more — 64 free text tools that run entirely in your browser. No signup, no upload, nothing ever leaves your device.

Textbench is a static web app: no signup, no backend, no per-visitor cost. Everything runs client-side.

## Primary pages
- [Home / the tool](https://textbench.app/)
- [About](https://textbench.app/about)
- [Privacy policy](https://textbench.app/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://textbench.app/terms)
- [Contact](https://textbench.app/contact)

## tools
- [Word Counter](https://textbench.app/tools/word-counter): A free word counter that updates as you type. See words, characters, sentences and reading time live — no signup, nothing uploaded, everything stays in your browser.
- [Character Counter](https://textbench.app/tools/character-counter): A free character counter showing characters with and without spaces, live as you type. Ideal for meta descriptions, bios and anywhere a character limit matters.
- [X / Twitter Counter](https://textbench.app/tools/twitter-character-counter): Count characters against X's 280-character post limit, live as you type, with the number remaining turning red once you go over. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Meta Description](https://textbench.app/tools/meta-description-length-checker): Check a meta description against the ~155-character length Google typically shows in search results, live as you type. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [YouTube Title](https://textbench.app/tools/youtube-title-length-checker): Check a video title against YouTube's 100-character title limit, live as you type, with the remaining count turning red once you go over. Free, browser-only.
- [Reading Time](https://textbench.app/tools/reading-time-calculator): Estimate reading time from your text. Paste an article or script and see how many minutes it takes to read aloud or silently, at your chosen pace.
- [Word Frequency](https://textbench.app/tools/word-frequency-counter): See which words you use most, sorted by count. Useful for spotting overused words in a draft, or building a quick keyword list. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Compare Texts](https://textbench.app/tools/compare-two-texts): Paste two texts and see the word count difference, character count difference, and how much vocabulary they share. A quick stats comparison, not a line-by-line diff.
- [UPPERCASE](https://textbench.app/tools/uppercase-converter): Convert any text to UPPERCASE instantly. Paste your text, copy the result — no signup, runs entirely in your browser.
- [lowercase](https://textbench.app/tools/lowercase-converter): Convert any text to lowercase instantly. Paste your text, copy the result — no signup, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Title Case](https://textbench.app/tools/title-case-converter): Convert text to Title Case, capitalizing the first letter of each word. Free, instant, runs in your browser.
- [Sentence case](https://textbench.app/tools/sentence-case-converter): Convert text to sentence case: lowercase throughout, with the first letter of each sentence capitalized. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Remove Duplicates](https://textbench.app/tools/remove-duplicate-lines): Remove duplicate lines from a list or block of text, keeping the first occurrence of each. Free, instant, nothing uploaded.
- [Extra Spaces](https://textbench.app/tools/remove-extra-spaces): Remove extra spaces and tabs from text, collapsing runs of whitespace into a single space per line. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Line Breaks](https://textbench.app/tools/remove-line-breaks): Remove line breaks from text, joining everything into a single paragraph with spaces between what used to be separate lines. Free, instant.
- [Empty Lines](https://textbench.app/tools/remove-empty-lines): Remove all empty and blank lines from a block of text or a list. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Sort Lines](https://textbench.app/tools/sort-lines-alphabetically): Sort a list of lines alphabetically, A→Z or Z→A. Free, instant, works entirely in your browser — paste a list and get it sorted.
- [Reverse Text](https://textbench.app/tools/reverse-text): Reverse text character by character — turn 'hello' into 'olleh'. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Reverse Line Order](https://textbench.app/tools/reverse-line-order): Reverse the order of lines in a list, keeping each line's text intact — the last line becomes the first. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Trim Lines](https://textbench.app/tools/trim-whitespace-from-lines): Strip leading and trailing whitespace from every line in a block of text, without touching spacing in the middle of a line. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Sort Z to A](https://textbench.app/tools/sort-lines-descending): Sort a list of lines in reverse alphabetical order, Z to A. Free, instant, works entirely in your browser — paste a list and get it sorted.
- [Line Numbers](https://textbench.app/tools/add-line-numbers): Add sequential line numbers to a block of text, one per line. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Slugify](https://textbench.app/tools/slugify-text): Convert any text into a clean, URL-safe slug: lowercase, hyphens instead of spaces, no special characters. Free, instant.
- [Text Repeater](https://textbench.app/tools/text-repeater): Repeat a word, phrase or block of text any number of times, one copy per line. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Find & Replace](https://textbench.app/tools/find-and-replace): Find and replace text online, with an optional regular-expression mode for pattern matching. Free, instant, nothing uploaded.
- [Regex Tester](https://textbench.app/tools/regex-tester): Test a regular expression against real text with live match highlighting and capture groups shown per match. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Email Regex Tester](https://textbench.app/tools/email-regex-tester): Test an email-validation regex against real addresses, with a working pattern pre-loaded. See exactly which addresses match and which don't, live. Free, client-side.
- [Phone Number Regex Tester](https://textbench.app/tools/phone-number-regex-tester): Test a phone-number regex against real numbers in different formats, with a working pattern pre-loaded. See exactly which formats match, live. Free, client-side.
- [CSV to JSON](https://textbench.app/tools/csv-to-json-converter): Convert CSV to a JSON array of objects, using the first row as keys. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [JSON to CSV](https://textbench.app/tools/json-to-csv-converter): Convert a JSON array of objects to CSV, using the first object's keys as columns. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [YAML to JSON](https://textbench.app/tools/yaml-to-json-converter): Convert YAML to JSON, pretty-printed with 2-space indentation. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [JSON to YAML](https://textbench.app/tools/json-to-yaml-converter): Convert JSON to clean, readable YAML. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [QR Code Generator](https://textbench.app/tools/qr-code-generator): Turn any text or URL into a scannable QR code, generated entirely in your browser. Free, instant, downloadable as a PNG.
- [Lorem Ipsum](https://textbench.app/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator): Generate lorem ipsum placeholder text, any number of paragraphs. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [aLtErNaTiNg cAsE](https://textbench.app/tools/alternating-case-converter): Convert text to aLtErNaTiNg CaSe, flipping upper and lower case letter by letter. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [InVeRsE cAsE](https://textbench.app/tools/inverse-case-converter): Invert the case of every letter in your text — uppercase becomes lowercase and lowercase becomes uppercase. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Extract Emails](https://textbench.app/tools/extract-emails-from-text): Pull every email address out of a block of text or a document, one per line, with duplicates removed. Free, instant, nothing uploaded.
- [Extract URLs](https://textbench.app/tools/extract-urls-from-text): Pull every http/https URL out of a block of text, one per line, with duplicates removed. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Extract Numbers](https://textbench.app/tools/extract-numbers-from-text): Pull every number out of a block of text, one per line, in the order they appear. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Base64 Encode](https://textbench.app/tools/base64-encode): Encode text to Base64 instantly. Free, browser-only — nothing you paste is uploaded anywhere.
- [Base64 Decode](https://textbench.app/tools/base64-decode): Decode a Base64 string back to readable text instantly. Free, browser-only, nothing uploaded.
- [URL Encode](https://textbench.app/tools/url-encode): Percent-encode text for safe use in a URL — spaces, symbols and special characters are escaped. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [URL Decode](https://textbench.app/tools/url-decode): Decode a percent-encoded URL string back to readable text. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [HTML Encode](https://textbench.app/tools/html-entity-encode): Escape text for safe use inside HTML — converts <, >, &, quotes and apostrophes to their HTML entity equivalents. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [HTML Decode](https://textbench.app/tools/html-entity-decode): Decode HTML entities (&amp;, &lt;, &#39;, and more) back to their original characters. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Text to Binary](https://textbench.app/tools/text-to-binary): Convert text to binary code (8-bit bytes, space-separated). Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Binary to Text](https://textbench.app/tools/binary-to-text): Convert binary code (space-separated 8-bit bytes) back to readable text. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Text to Hex](https://textbench.app/tools/text-to-hex): Convert text to hexadecimal byte values, space-separated. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Hex to Text](https://textbench.app/tools/hex-to-text): Convert hexadecimal byte values back to readable text. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Text → Morse](https://textbench.app/tools/morse-code-translator): Translate text into Morse code — letters, numbers and basic punctuation. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [Morse → Text](https://textbench.app/tools/morse-code-to-text): Translate Morse code (dots and dashes) back into readable text. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [ROT13](https://textbench.app/tools/rot13-cipher): Encode or decode text with the ROT13 cipher — a simple letter-rotation cipher that's its own inverse. Free, instant, browser-only.
- [JSON Formatter](https://textbench.app/tools/json-formatter): Paste minified or messy JSON and get it pretty-printed with 2-space indentation, instantly. Free, browser-only, catches syntax errors as it formats.
- [JSON Validator](https://textbench.app/tools/json-validator): Paste JSON and instantly see whether it's valid — and exactly where the syntax error is if it isn't. Free, browser-only, nothing uploaded.
- [JSON Minifier](https://textbench.app/tools/json-minifier): Strip all whitespace from JSON down to the smallest valid form, in one line. Free, browser-only, useful before pasting JSON into a size-limited field.
- [Markdown to HTML](https://textbench.app/tools/markdown-to-html-converter): Convert Markdown to clean HTML — headers, bold/italic, links, lists, code blocks and blockquotes. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Markdown to Plain Text](https://textbench.app/tools/markdown-to-plain-text): Strip Markdown formatting down to clean plain text — headers, bold/italic, links and lists all lose their markup, keeping just the words. Free, instant, runs entirely in your browser.
- [MD5 Hash](https://textbench.app/tools/md5-hash-generator): Generate the MD5 hash of any text, entirely in your browser. Free, instant, nothing uploaded.
- [SHA-256 Hash](https://textbench.app/tools/sha256-hash-generator): Generate the SHA-256 hash of any text using your browser's built-in Web Crypto API. Free, instant, nothing uploaded.
- [UUID Generator](https://textbench.app/tools/uuid-generator): Generate random UUID v4 identifiers, one or many at once. Free, instant, cryptographically random, browser-only.
- [Password Generator](https://textbench.app/tools/random-password-generator): Generate a strong, random password with your choice of length and character types. Free, cryptographically random, browser-only — your password is never sent anywhere.
- [Strikethrough](https://textbench.app/tools/strikethrough-text-generator): Generate strikethrough text you can paste anywhere — social media, chat apps, anywhere plain Unicode text is accepted. Free, instant.
- [Upside Down](https://textbench.app/tools/upside-down-text-generator): Flip your text upside down using Unicode look-alike characters — paste it anywhere plain text works. Free, instant.
- [Bold Unicode](https://textbench.app/tools/bold-text-generator): Generate bold-looking text using Unicode mathematical bold characters — works anywhere plain text is accepted, including places without bold formatting. Free, instant.
